title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Location: Remote (Brazil)

Working Hours: 9am–5pm EST (some flexibility)

Openings: 3

Contract Duration: 8-month contract with potential extensions

Structure: CLT (non-negotiable)

Start Date: April 6th, 2026

Interview Process: 2 rounds!

Job Description

In this role, you will support infrastructure operations for a suite of software products by managing permissions, handling access requests via Slack, and troubleshooting one-off operational issues as they arise. You will assist with releases for new services and perform ongoing patching and maintenance across cloud infrastructure, primarily within an Amazon Linux environment. Using AWS services such as EC2 and Security Groups, along with Terraform for infrastructure as code, you will follow established configurations to build, modify, and maintain cloud resources. The role also requires writing scripts to support automation and deployment workflows, collaborating closely with engineering teams to ensure stable and secure operations. While the environment is mostly Linux-based, there may be occasional interaction with Windows systems, though this is secondary to the core responsibilities.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 3–5 years of professional experience as a DevOps Engineer
  • Strong AWS experience, including EC2, Security Groups, command line usage, and ECS Fargate
  • Experience with GitHub Actions and Jenkins (CI/CD pipelines, automation, etc.)
  • Hands-on Terraform experience — both command line and coding — to build cloud infrastructure, create/modify resources, and update security group permissions following existing patterns
  • Linux environment expertise: Amazon Linux, system maintenance, troubleshooting, and scripting for installation and deployment
  • Scripting & automation skills (Packer, Terraform, or Ansible preferred)
  • Strong critical thinking — must be able to take tickets and work independently without heavy guidance
  • Excellent communication and proactive updates; must know when to escalate or ask for help
  • Experience reviewing and remediating vulnerability and FinOps tickets (cost optimization, workload cleanup, etc.)

Nice to Have Skills & Experience

  • Windows experience

Compensation & Benefits

20,000-28,000 BRL per month

All CLT statutory benefits will apply for this position. Full benefits shared upon a video screening.

Para isso, contamos com mais de 4 mil colaboradores(as) engajados(as) e comprometidos(as).Acreditamos que por meio da inclusão e da diversidade construímos um ambiente seguro e de pertencimento que valoriza e respeita as pessoas integralmente. Assim, incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas com deficiência, de diferentes raças e etnias, gêneros, orientações sexuais, identidades de gênero e gerações para todas as nossas vagas.

Estamos com oportunidade, para profissionais Médicos (as) que queiram integrar a equipe de TEA, atuando como Coordenador (a) de programas, na SulAmérica.

Principais atuações:

Temos uma oportunidade para atuar como Médico(a) no nosso time de TEA. O profissional será responsável pela definição da operação da equipe de médicos e enfermeiros, desenhando processos em conjunto com a área e demais stakeholders.

Atuará avaliando o levantamento e a análise de informações sobre aspectos de negócio, financeiros, tempo, risco e escopo, a fim de realizar e entregar planos de ação para o alcance dos objetivos dos programas e projetos.

Será responsável pela integração do trabalho, viabilizando uma comunicação mais eficiente entre todos os envolvidos, administrando equipes multifuncionais de diferentes superintendências e adequando recursos para atender às prioridades das áreas. Outras informações:

Modalidade de contrato: PJ

Carga horária: 40h semanais de segunda a sexta, presenciais em São Paulo - SP

title: Gerente de planejamento estratégico

- Graduação completa.

- Experiência em planejamento estratégico.

- Ter atuado junto ao C-level para desdobrar iniciativas estratégicas em planos de ação.

- Experiência em gestão de equipe.

- Conhecimento em finanças e produtos de seguros.

- Habilidade em gestão de projetos.

Habilidades e competências:

- Excelente comunicação.

- Habilidade de negociação e influência.

- Forte capacidade de relacionamento.

- Capacidade de liderança.

- Proatividade.

- Organização.

title: Fullstack Developer (São Paulo)
description:
Enabley is hiring: Fullstack Developer (São Paulo)

Enabley is a fast-growing learning technology startup headquartered in Israel with a substantial and growing customer base in Brazil.

We're looking for a skilled Fullstack Developer to join our international product development group, working full-time with our local team in São Paulo!

Our platform serves companies with deskless workforces in industries like retail, transportation, manufacturing, healthcare etc. (e.g., Vivo, Coca-Cola, Chilli Beans, Unilever and many others). We help employees learn and grow on the go, whether through desktop or mobile, ensuring they stay connected to their company, no matter where they are.

What You'll Do

  • Collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, and designers across global teams to roll out new features quickly and improve existing ones.
  • Develop, test, and maintain scalable web applications with full responsiveness for both desktop and mobile.
  • Take end-to-end ownership of features—from understanding the need to delivering production-ready code.
  • Build and enhance systems using Java, Spring, React, Redux, Node.js, MongoDB, and AWS cloud services.
  • Write clean, maintainable code and follow best practices for software development.
  • Use modern AI-assisted development tools to accelerate productivity and code quality.
  • Support and extend product features that leverage generative AI, such as intelligent knowledge assistants, automated content generation and more.
  • Work with tight schedules and changing priorities, actively seeking solutions.

What We Offer

  • A dynamic and supportive work environment with a team that values innovation, collaboration, and getting the job done with a smile :)
  • The chance to impact learning experiences for millions of deskless workers, across industries and continents.
  • Daily exposure to modern AI development practices and a product stack that actively incorporates AI into customer-facing features.
  • A hybrid work model – at least 2 days a week in our São Paulo offices (Berrini/Pinheiros area; this is a must), with the rest remote.

Who You Are

  • Experienced Fullstack Developer: 5+ years building software products in real-world, production environments.
  • Tech Stack: Proficiency in Java, Spring, React, Redux, MongoDB, Node.js, AWS, and CI/CD workflows.
  • AI Mindset: Familiar with using AI tools to enhance development workflows. Enthusiastic about helping build AI-powered product features and curious about how AI is transforming software user interactions.
  • Cloud: Experience developing and operating in AWS environments, using services like S3, EC2, Lambda, CloudWatch, etc.
  • Fluent in English: Strong communication skills in English are essential, as it is our primary working language.
  • Self-Starter: You're motivated, resourceful, and capable of taking initiative—even when specifications are still being gathered.
  • Team Player: Collaborative, curious, thrives in fast-paced environments, and fun to work with :)

Ready to code the future of learning?

Apply now and join us in shaping the future of learning for deskless workers!

description:

  • Experiência sólida em agência de publicidade
  • Forte conhecimento em mídia digital e tradicional

Desde 1912, a WMcCANN é guiada pelo mesmo DNA: "Truth Well Told".

Com "Truth to Impact", sistema operacional globalmente integrado, conectamos ideias a resultados desde o início. Esse processo multidisciplinar integra estratégia, mídia e tecnologia, sendo impulsionado por criatividade, dados, ferramentas e conhecimento.

title: Mid-level DevOps Engineer
description:
Job Opening: Mid-Level DevOps Engineer – Brazil (NFQ)

Join NFQ!

We are a global consulting firm specialized in business, technology, and operations, with over 2,500 professionals across national and international offices. At NFQ, we offer a different consulting model: Flexible | Scalable | Specialized | Client-Centric.

At NFQ, we are strengthening our DevOps capabilities in Brazil and are looking for a Mid-Level DevOps Engineer to join our team.

You will work as part of an NFQ DevOps team, collaborating with engineers in Europe, and supporting mission-critical systems for a global financial client.

This role involves production environments and planned release activities, including a predictable weekend rotation.

Responsibilities

  • Design, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions)
  • Support deployments across:
  • Kubernetes / OpenShift
  • AWS
  • On-prem / bare-metal infrastructure
  • Automate infrastructure and application configuration using Ansible
  • Support and troubleshoot Unix/Linux systems, with Windows integration where needed
  • Work with monitoring and observability (Dynatrace, ELK stack)
  • Participate in planned releases, post-release validation, and incident analysis
  • Collaborate with teams using GitHub, Jira, and Confluence
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to knowledge sharing
  • Improve documentation, standards, and DevOps practices within NFQ
  • Use AI-assisted tools to increase efficiency and delivery quality

Requirements

  • English level: B2+ (spoken and written – daily communication)
  • Completed degree or equivalent professional experience in one of the following areas: Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or other technology-related fields
  • Strong Unix/Linux administration experience
  • Solid experience with Ansible (playbooks and roles)
  • Confident use of Git in collaborative workflows
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins and/or GitHub Actions)
  • Experience running workloads on Kubernetes / OpenShift
  • Scripting or coding skills (Bash, Python, or similar)
  • Experience supporting production environments
  • Willingness to participate in rotational weekend release work

Nice to Have

  • AWS experience
  • Exposure to bare-metal infrastructure
  • ELK stack administration
  • Dynatrace configuration and dashboards
  • Windows Server administration
  • Experience in banking, finance, or FX
  • Exposure to regulated environments
  • Experience working in Kanban teams

What We Offer

  • Work in a dynamic, international environment with global mobility opportunities.
  • Continuous learning and official certifications.
  • Language classes to boost your global career.
  • A personalized development plan with mentorship and performance-based growth.

CLT contract benefits:

  • Health & dental insurance
  • Life insurance
  • Meal voucher
  • Transportation allowance

And much more: a flexible work environment, internal events, travel, and wellness initiatives.

Learn more about us: nfq.es

title: Warehouse Assistant- Talent Pipeline
description:
Note: We're proactively identifying strong profiles for future openings. This position is not immediately available.

OUR MISSION

At Evernex, we believe millions of IT parts thrown away each year deserve a second life. That's why we step in and give them a new purpose. From hospitals to banks to airports, we ensure critical systems stay operational while helping businesses reduce costs and minimize environmental impact.

With teams across the world — from Paris to Melbourne, Dubai to São Paulo, Casablanca to Kuala Lumpur — we are building a future where IT is greener, smarter, and more sustainable. How does that sound to you?

More information is available at

Why this role matters

As our Stock Keeper in Brazil, you play a key role in ensuring that our logistics operations run smoothly and efficiently.

You are responsible for managing warehouse operations, ensuring spare parts and equipment are received, stored, and dispatched accurately and on time. Your work directly supports business continuity for our customers across the region.

You will independently manage the warehouse and ensure that all logistics processes align with Evernex standards and policies.

How will you make an impact?

Our Stock Keeper ensures that warehouse operations are organized, compliant, and efficient — supporting both internal teams and external partners.

You are responsible for, but not limited to:

  • Managing warehouse operations in compliance with Evernex policies and vision.
  • Overseeing receiving, storage, inventory control, and dispatch activities.
  • Monitoring stock levels and ensuring accurate inventory management.
  • Producing regular reports (IN/OUT status, dead stock, inventory accuracy, etc.).
  • Coordinating with clients, suppliers, transport companies, and internal teams.
  • Ensuring proper space management and warehouse organization.
  • Inspecting tools and equipment and overseeing general maintenance.
  • Monitoring service quality and responding to operational feedback.
  • Ensuring warehouse productivity targets are achieved.

This is an individual contributor role — no team management is involved.

What makes you a great fit

We're looking for someone who combines operational discipline, organization, and accountability.

Ideally you:

  • Have proven experience in stock keeping or warehouse operations.
  • Understand warehouse procedures and best practices.
  • Have hands-on experience with warehouse management systems and databases.
  • Demonstrate strong organizational and reporting skills.
  • Are comfortable working independently and taking full ownership of warehouse activities.
  • Communicate effectively with suppliers, transport partners, and internal teams.
  • Speak Portuguese, English and Spanish fluently.

Certifications in Warehouse Management, Logistics, or equivalent experience are preferred.

Why You'll Love Working Here

Join Evernex and you'll contribute to meaningful global operations that support sustainable IT lifecycle management.

We keep things collaborative and people focused — less hierarchy, more teamwork. You'll find trust, flexibility, and the opportunity to take ownership of your role.

And along the way, you will:

  • Work for a global leader in sustainable IT solutions.
  • Be part of a multicultural and fast-paced environment.
  • Grow through continuous learning and development opportunities.
  • Contribute to a greener and more responsible IT industry.

title: Principal Data Engineer
description:
Description

We are looking for a highly skilled Principal Data Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will lead architectural decisions and set standards for how we design, build and maintain our data platform and data-driven systems.

This is a hands-on role with no direct people management, but you will act as a strong technical reference, guiding others and driving initiatives that shape the future of our data ecosystem. You will work across data engineering and personalization use cases, helping transform raw data into actionable insights and intelligent user experiences.

Responsibilities

  • Make architectural and design decisions for our data pipelines and infrastructure, ensuring scalability, performance and long-term maintainability.
  • Write production-ready TypeScript code (AWS Lambda, CDK, Zod validation) to support data and backend workflows.
  • Design, build and maintain data pipelines using AWS services and databases such as Aurora, Snowflake and DynamoDB.
  • Develop and optimize ETL/ELT processes to ingest, transform and load data efficiently.
  • Work with vector databases and embeddings to enable semantic search and personalization capabilities.
  • Apply personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation to improve data-driven user experiences.
  • Optimize data models and structures within Snowflake for cost-efficiency and usability.
  • Ensure data quality, accuracy and consistency through validation, monitoring and testing practices.
  • Collaborate with engineers, analysts and product stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Review code, contribute to architectural discussions and mentor other engineers.
  • Continuously evaluate new technologies and methodologies to improve our data platform.

Technology Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in data engineering or related roles. We are flexible for candidates with strong recent experience in AWS data pipelines and vector embeddings or personalization systems.
  • Strong experience with AWS services, especially Lambda, CDK and data-related infrastructure.
  • Experience writing production TypeScript.
  • Solid knowledge of Snowflake and relational databases such as Aurora or PostgreSQL.
  • Experience building and maintaining data pipelines in cloud environments.
  • Advanced SQL skills.
  • Experience working with vector databases and embeddings for semantic search or similar use cases.
  • Understanding of personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation.
  • Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
  • Experience with BI tools or big data technologies is a plus.

Profile Requirements

  • Strong technical leadership and ability to make architectural decisions.
  • Comfortable owning complex initiatives end to end.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-functionally.
  • Proactive, hands-on and comfortable in evolving environments.
